categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Touches `test/functional/p2p_blocksonly.py` to fix the verification of transaction announcement suppression to block-relay-only peers.
categories.rationale: Fixes a vacuous test assertion where checking for txid instead of wtxid allowed the test to pass even if the node improperly announced the transaction to block-relay-only peers. The underlying node relay behavior is not reported broken, but fixing the negative test assertion ensures future regressions in transaction privacy and relay filtering are caught.
